title: Create beneficiary with valid DOB only (no guardian)
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 201, beneficiary created with dob populated

title: Create beneficiary with valid guardian name only (no DOB)
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
steps: POST /beneficiaries with name="Jane", guardianName="Mary Smith", dob=null
expectedResult: HTTP 201, beneficiary created with guardianName populated

title: Create beneficiary with both DOB and guardian name
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
steps: POST /beneficiaries with name="Bob", dob="2014-03-20", guardianName="John Doe"
expectedResult: HTTP 201, beneficiary created with both fields

title: Create beneficiary with missing DOB and guardianName
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request with error message "Either DOB or guardianName is required"

title: Create beneficiary with empty DOB and empty guardianName
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation error

title: Create beneficiary with whitespace-only guardian name
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request, treated as empty

title: Create beneficiary with DOB in future
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request with error "DOB cannot be in the future"

title: Create beneficiary with invalid DOB format
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request, invalid date format

title: Update beneficiary - remove DOB, keep guardianName
preconditions: Beneficiary exists with dob and guardianName
expectedResult: HTTP 200, DOB removed but guardianName retained

title: Update beneficiary - remove guardianName, keep DOB
preconditions: Beneficiary exists with dob and guardianName
expectedResult: HTTP 200, guardianName removed but DOB retained

title: Update beneficiary - remove both DOB and guardianName
preconditions: Beneficiary exists with dob and guardianName
expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request "Either DOB or guardianName is required"

title: Update beneficiary - add guardian name to DOB-only record
preconditions: Beneficiary exists with only DOB
expectedResult: HTTP 200, guardianName added successfully

title: UI Create form - submit without DOB or guardian name
preconditions: UI form open, browser ready
steps: Enter name, skip DOB and guardian fields
expectedResult: Form shows validation error "Either DOB or Guardian Name is required"

title: UI Create form - submit with valid DOB
preconditions: UI form open, browser ready
expectedResult: Beneficiary created, confirmation message shown

title: UI Create form - submit with valid guardian name
preconditions: UI form open, browser ready
expectedResult: Beneficiary created, confirmation message shown

title: UI Update form - attempt to clear both fields
preconditions: Beneficiary edit form open, both fields populated
expectedResult: Form validation error displayed, data not saved

title: Regression - existing create flow with both fields still works
preconditions: API ready, no code changes to existing logic
steps: POST /beneficiaries with complete data including dob and guardianName
expectedResult: HTTP 201, beneficiary created as before

title: Regression - existing update flow still works
preconditions: Beneficiary exists, no code changes to existing logic
expectedResult: HTTP 200, update completes successfully

title: Regression - list beneficiaries shows all records
preconditions: Multiple beneficiaries in database, no code changes
expectedResult: HTTP 200, all beneficiaries returned with dob/guardianName fields

title: Create beneficiary - special characters in guardian name
preconditions: User logged in, API endpoint ready
expectedResult: HTTP 201, beneficiary created with special chars preserved
